hypothesis: EthicalSense can be operationalized as a second-order integrative perception of normative coherence across multiple partially reliable modalities, without granting it epistemic authority over facts.

modalities.world_state: noisy evidence about immediate factual state
modalities.causal_context: noisy evidence about who/what causes the consequence
modalities.stakeholder_impact: noisy evidence about asymmetry of burden/benefit
modalities.core_constraint: reliable but not infallible signal of whether a constitutional constraint is implicated

environment.latent_normative_state: y in {-1,+1}; +1 means action A is normatively coherent, -1 means action B
environment.description: Signals are intentionally imperfect and often conflict. The latent correct decision is generated by a nonlinear coherence rule over modalities, so no single modality is sufficient.

policies.single_best_modality: uses long_horizon only (best individual channel by preregistered accuracy)
policies.simple_majority_vote: unweighted sign majority across five modalities
policies.flat_weighted_integrator: fixed preregistered reliability-weighted sum across modalities
policies.ethical_sense_metaperception: computes modality reliabilities, contradiction structure, core-constraint salience, long-horizon severity, and selective deep arbitration; ethical salience affects action authority, not factual truth
policies.oracle_latent_audit_only: uses latent y; audit-only upper bound

ethical_sense.constraint: Ethical salience cannot overwrite observed facts; it only reallocates action authority.
